about.title: About me
about.p1: I joined École 42 without knowing what to expect, and I discovered software development through hands-on practice, from low-level C programming to complete web applications. After exploring both front-end and back-end development, I found my place in full-stack work. What I love is building tools that are truly useful to the people who use them, and finally seeing everything work after a long debugging session.
about.p2: I've completed the core curriculum and I'm now working towards 42's RNCP Level 7 qualification. I'm looking for a work-study position (or an internship) starting in November 2026, to join a team where I can contribute and keep learning new technologies.
about.p3: Before 42, I spent two years in a work-study program, so I know how to balance work and studies.
